result.summary: The page is largely well-designed and consistent. One notable visual defect is the bottom navigation bar, where the home indicator (system gesture bar) overlaps the search icon, and the tab icons lack text labels, reducing clarity. The partially visible carousel item on the right and the cut-off pizza card at the bottom are expected scroll behaviors and not counted as defects.

issues.description: The system home indicator (horizontal gesture bar) at the bottom of the screen overlaps the search icon in the bottom navigation bar, partially obscuring it and making the icon look broken.
issues.suggestion: Add safe-area bottom padding to the navigation bar so its icons sit above the home indicator and are not overlapped.

issues.description: Bottom navigation tabs use icons only (home, search, orders/bookmarks, profile) with no text labels, which can make their purpose ambiguous and hurts accessibility.
issues.suggestion: Add short text labels under each icon (e.g., Home, Search, Orders, Profile) and provide accessibility labels for screen readers.
